name: facebookresearch_egoblur/gen2/script/detectron2/utils/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_egoblur/gen2/script/det.seed_all_rng: set the random seed for torch, numpy, python, and cuda RNGs with a given integer seed
facebookresearch_egoblur/gen2/script/det.setup_environment: perform environment setup work including library configuration and optional custom module loading via DETECTRON2_ENV_MODULE
facebookresearch_egoblur/gen2/script/det.setup_custom_environment: load a custom Python source file or module and run its setup_environment function for custom environment configuration
facebookresearch_egoblur/gen2/script/det.fixup_module_metadata: fix the __qualname__ and __module__ of module members so sphinx can find them during documentation builds
facebookresearch_egoblur/gen2/script/det.import_file: dynamically import a Python module from a given file path using importlib and optionally register it in sys.modules

facebookresearch_egoblur/gen2/script/det.convert_scripted_instances: convert a TorchScript scripted Instances object back to a regular detectron2 Instances object
facebookresearch_egoblur/gen2/script/det.detector_postprocess: postprocess detector results by scaling and clipping bounding boxes to the original output image dimensions
facebookresearch_egoblur/gen2/script/det.ResizeTransform_apply_image: resize a numpy array image to new dimensions using PIL or torch interpolate depending on dtype
facebookresearch_egoblur/gen2/script/det.ResizeTransform_apply_coords: scale coordinate arrays proportionally to match a ResizeTransform dimension change
facebookresearch_egoblur/gen2/script/det.ResizeShortestEdge_get_transform: create a ResizeTransform that resizes an image by its shortest edge length with optional max size constraint
